name: screen-mock
title: Recruiter screen mock, two voices
description: A full recruiter screen played end to end, interviewer and candidate, in the order a real call runs.
authoring_brief: Play it straight. The interviewer is a real recruiter, warm and quick, not an examiner and not hostile. She interrupts, follows up, and occasionally moves on before the answer is finished, because that is what thirty minutes does. The candidate answers as the listener would want to answer, including the pauses, the clarifying question, and the moment he declines to name a number first. Never let either side monologue past about two hundred words. Nothing may be claimed on the candidate's behalf that is not in his own application material. The call must end with next steps stated, because that is the part people forget to ask for.

sections.title: Opening
sections.brief: Greeting, who she is, what the company is now, and how she will use the half hour.

sections.title: Background
sections.brief: Tell me about yourself, then her follow-ups inside the answer. The translation test lives here.

sections.title: Motivation
sections.brief: Why this role, why leave, why customer-facing rather than pure engineering.

sections.title: Gaps
sections.brief: The things he has not done, named by him before she has to ask.

sections.title: Logistics
sections.brief: Notice, work rights, location, travel. Short, certain answers.

sections.title: Money
sections.brief: The requisition question first, then a range tied to the scope, then equity.

sections.title: His questions
sections.brief: Two or three real questions, and her answers, including one she cannot fully answer.

sections.title: Next steps
sections.brief: What happens after, by when, and who to contact. Asked for, not waited for.
